WHOLE HOMES, KITCHENS, BATHROOMS, BASEMENTS, ADDITIONS & MORE

Renovating KC is a full-service Kansas City design + remodel team delivering high-quality kitchens, baths, basements, and whole-home transformations from concept to completion.

Renovating KC Design + Remodel is honored to be featured in KC Home & Style Magazine's "Building Kansas City" edition. Recognized as one of the companies helping transform and remodel homes in Kansas City. We are proud to deliver award-winning kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, basement finishing projects, and whole-home renovation services in Kansas City.

Read Our Feature

Renovating KC Recognized for Excellence in Kansas City Remodeling & Design

Renovating KC is proud to be recognized as an award-winning Kansas City remodeling and design-build company, earning multiple REMY Awards for excellence in residential remodeling. Adding to this distinction, the founder of Renovating KC, Steven has been named one of Ingram’s 2026 40 Under Forty, highlighting his leadership and impact in the industry.

The Renovating KC team has been honored with Gold, Silver, and All-Star awards for standout kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, basement finishes, home additions, and whole-home transformations throughout the Kansas City metro. Our award-winning Kansas City remodeling team is ready to help you create your dream home.

INTERIOR DESIGN TEAM
Meet Our Award-Winning Kansas City Interior Design Team

FULL SERVICE DESIGN + REMODELING

FULL HOME REMODELS

Reimagine your entire living space—updating the layout, design, and functionality to better suit your lifestyle. Whether you're modernizing an older home or creating a more open flow, a whole-home renovation brings new life to every room.

Learn More
KITCHENS

Whether you're dreaming of an open-concept layout, more storage, or updated finishes and appliances, a well-designed kitchen can completely transform the heart of your home into a space that's both beautiful and built for everyday living.

Learn More
BATHROOMS

Your day usually begins and ends in your bathroom - it’s one of the most used rooms in a house. Create a spa-like retreat that combines comfort, peace and functionality that enhances your daily routines and adds lasting value to your home.

Learn More
BASEMENTS

Maximize your space and create functional, inviting spaces to enjoy. Whether you’re envisioning a home theater, playroom, or additional living area, we transform unfinished or outdated basements into comfortable, customized extensions of your home.

WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A KITCHEN REMODEL AND KITCHEN RENOVATION?

While the terms are often used interchangeably, there is a subtle difference between a kitchen remodel and a kitchen renovation:

A kitchen renovation typically refers to updating or restoring what's already there. This might include replacing cabinets, countertops, flooring, or appliances without changing the layout of the kitchen. It’s about giving your existing kitchen a fresh look and improved function.

A kitchen remodel, on the other hand, involves a more significant transformation. This could mean changing the layout, removing walls, relocating plumbing or electrical, or completely redesigning the space to improve flow, function, and aesthetics.

In short, renovation focuses on upgrading the existing kitchen, while remodeling is about reimagining and rebuilding it. At Renovating KC, we offer both services and help you decide which approach best fits your goals, budget, and lifestyle.
